description: V3: locked geographic layout, independent procedural artwork, and data-driven gameplay content with stable IDs for quests, dialogue, NPCs, loot and encounters. Corrected 2.5D architecture scale with matched physical building bounds.

metadata.scalePass: v0.12.1 — Quays buildings resized with collision and entrances; saved inventories and quests unchanged.
metadata.questRepair: v0.12.2: quest-related objects reassigned to physically resized buildings; no quest IDs or stages changed.
metadata.mapOverhaul: v0.13: rebuilding terrain for corrected scale, repaired south pier route, entrances, and objective clearance.

note: Hub intentionally compacted for Pinewall-scale layout; static IDs stable.

workyard.layout: south-east forge bench with open working approach

hub.name: Salvager’s Rest
hub.desc: Salvager’s Rest: a compact walled harbor town around Lantern Square. North is the city road, south the Rest Docks, east the passage to the Outer Quays.

quays.name: The Outer Quays
quays.desc: The ruined commercial waterfront south-west of the Rest: Salt Yards, Customs Hill, Warehouse Row, the Old Fish Market, the Wreckers’ Camp, the Broken Quays and the Boathouse Slip. North is the Ashwood; south is the sea.

whisperreed.name: Whisperreed
whisperreed.description: Quiet long-range hunting; reduced acoustic signature

brineguard.name: Brineguard
brineguard.description: Breaks plated monster parts; higher impact and armor penetration

tideglass.name: Tideglass
tideglass.description: Refined pressure control; improved range and accuracy

containers.name: Hunter’s Cache under the Grove Tree

nodes.text: You heading beyond the seawall? The storm left more wreckage than we can count.

choices.text: Any news from the tidal caves?
My equipment was lost. Can I borrow a basic kit?

nodes.text: An empty skiff came home without its crew. Find the mooring tag and come back with it.
Good. The West Passage is clear. Don’t count on the lower roads staying dry.
Low tide opens the lower quays. Rising water closes the cart track. Storm Gate stays reachable inland.
The harbor cannot replace what you lost. Take a worn arbalest and six bolts—but come back alive this time.
The Salt Widow cavern still holds a marker from the missing party. Look for signs near the cave mouth and return with whatever survived.
The cave floods when the tide rises. Do not stay longer than you must.
In this harbor we write the lost twice: once at home quay, once in the pilot ledger. The copies disagree.
Find the second ledger in the Customs Warehouse. I need the original, not another rumor.
Bring it back intact. Names matter here.
If these entries are true, someone altered the salvage records after the storm.
Then the unmarked cargo must be traced.
Dry rope costs less than a drowned salvager. What supplies do you need?
Rations, bandages, oil. Count your weight before leaving.
Don’t drag every crate home. Take the things that keep you alive.
Steel, cordage, pressure seals. Bring me the right materials and I can forge something worth carrying.
That fitting came from an experimental batch. I’d test it before trusting it.
The sea strips heat faster than courage. Let me see your wounds.
Keep your bandages dry. Salt water is no friend to an open wound.
Past this gate is Saltwatch proper. Salvagers use the controlled passage to the southeast.
The city is not accessible in this prototype.
Wreckers say the Drowned King sank half the missing ships. Too convenient a story.
There are false sightings every storm season. Follow the paperwork, not the sea tales.
Start with the ruined Watch Store. Someone wanted the records gone.
The salt eats poorly spun rope. Keep your lines dry and double-knot them.
Check the tide markers before leaving the harbor. There is always an inland route home.
Old pressure seals need careful maintenance. I would rather fix a launcher than explain a failure.
Storms leave cargo everywhere. They also leave wreckers; mind who you trust.

weather.name: Clear Coast
weather.description: Open skies and good visibility; exposed movement is easy to spot.

weather.name: Low Clouds
weather.description: Grey light, calm shore and a little concealment.

weather.name: Sea Fog
weather.description: Mist muffles sightlines. Enemies still hear you.

weather.name: Coastal Rain
weather.description: Rain masks footsteps, wets clothing and reduces shot control.

weather.name: Red Salt Squall
weather.description: Sudden hard rain, rough surf and wind. Pilot skiff unsafe.

factions.name: Saltwatch Harbor Compact
factions.description: Customs officials, reef pilots and harbor guards who protect the lawful port. Protect civilians and confront unauthorized wreckers.

factions.name: Licensed Salvagers
factions.description: Independent salvagers licensed to work the storm coast. Cooperate with Compact patrols but compete for salvage.

factions.name: Unlicensed Wreckers
factions.description: Unauthorized salvage bands willing to ambush crews and steal cargo. This is a working name for local hostile groups.

factions.name: Independent Harbor Crews
factions.description: Fisherfolk, repairers and independents who avoid violence unless threatened.

items.name: Salt-bitten Scrap
items.description: Corroded metal recovered from ruined works

items.name: Dry Rope
items.description: Reliable rope kept above the high-tide line

items.name: Red Salt Crystals
items.description: Crystallized coastal salt useful for preservation

items.name: Lantern Oil
items.description: A sealed bottle for lanterns and repairs

items.name: Clean Bandage
items.description: Stops ordinary bleeding

items.name: Saltwatch Ration
items.description: A preserved meal for expeditions

items.name: Pressure Seal
items.description: Machined launcher pressure fitting

items.name: Experimental Wickcaster Cartridge
items.description: Imported launch charge of uncertain origin

items.name: Brineback Salt Plate
items.description: Armor-like plating recovered from a Brineback

items.name: Redhook Gull Feather
items.description: Distinctive scarlet scavenger flight feather

items.name: Salt Widow Shell
items.description: Camouflaged carapace from a coastal cave hunter

items.name: Second Pilot Ledger
items.description: Missing shipping ledger with contradictory names and dates

items.name: Empty Skiff Mooring Tag
items.description: Proof of origin tied to the storm-battered vessel

items.name: Unmarked Cargo Manifest
items.description: A record that disputes the official cargo account

items.name: Waterline Evidence
items.description: An unusual item recovered near the tidal cave

items.name: False King’s Wake Report
items.description: A suspicious report blaming missing crews on a legendary calamity

items.name: Harbor Tincture
items.description: Basic treatment from the Harbor Clinic

items.name: Broken Pilot Compass
items.description: Salvage from the storm fleet

items.name: Shipwork Gears
items.description: Usable brass gears from a dockside winch

items.name: Brass Survey Lens
items.description: A ship surveyor’s optical instrument

items.name: Arbalest Bolt
items.description: Iron-tipped arbalest bolt

items.name: Wickcaster Cell
items.description: Sealed low-pressure launcher charge

items.name: Used Arbalest
items.description: Heavy crossbow launcher; loud, slow, hard-hitting

items.name: Wickcaster
items.description: Short-range experimental pressure launcher

items.name: Hunting Arrow
items.description: Feathered salvage arrow, recoverable after a hunt

items.name: Smoke Pot
items.description: Breaks vision temporarily, but does not erase pursuit

items.name: Decoy Rattle
items.description: Thrown diversion to draw enemies toward a sound

items.name: Tempered Salt Heart
items.description: A scarce hardened heart recovered from an elite Brineback plate break

items.name: Brineback Tusk
items.description: Tusk pried free through carefully aimed attacks

items.name: Salt Widow Claw
items.description: A snapped mineral-hardened folded claw

items.name: Redhook Beak
items.description: Broken hooked beak recovered from a Redhook Gull

items.name: Saltcliff Shed Horn
items.description: Naturally shed coastal horn; no hunt required

items.name: Salvager Bow
items.description: A quiet bow produced for Saltwatch salvage crews

items.name: Longbolt
items.description: Longwatch precision ammunition. Sold by the quartermaster; not interchangeable with arbalest bolts.

items.name: Tidemaw Gill Sac
items.description: A ruptured teal gill sac. It still smells of the deep tide.

items.name: Tidemaw Jaw Plate
items.description: A crab-armored jaw plate studded with salt-crystal teeth.

items.name: Tidemaw Tail Fin
items.description: A barnacled tail fin, heavy as a door.

items.name: Ola’s Hammer
items.description: A small smithing hammer with O.M. scratched into the grip.

items.name: Tarnished Locket
items.description: A salt-green locket with a faded portrait of a sailor.

items.name: Senn’s Tally Book
items.description: A water-stained ledger of crates, names and dates.

items.name: Wire Spectacles
items.description: Bent wire spectacles, one lens cracked.

items.name: Brass Compass
items.description: A brass compass engraved with a crew’s initials.

living_expeditions.note: Optional, repeatable harbor commissions. Separate from the canonical five-story quest chain; all objectives must be earned inside a successful expedition.

contracts.title: Unclaimed Quay Salvage
contracts.description: Recover cargo from three different salvage caches and return before the tide closes the shoreline.

contracts.title: The Brineback Watch
contracts.description: Keep the shipping lanes safe by driving back two Brinebacks.

contracts.title: Redhook Nesting Survey
contracts.description: Redhook Gulls have been harassing harbor crews. Thin their numbers and bring back a field report.

contracts.title: Crystallized Plate Sample
contracts.description: Damage the dorsal crystal plate of a Brineback. The smithy needs a sound sample, not just a carcass.

contracts.title: Folded-Claw Inspection
contracts.description: Recover field observations from a Salt Widow by shattering one of its folded claw guards.

contracts.title: Tracks Through the Salt
contracts.description: Trace disturbed sand, broken brush and monster signs. Do not needlessly provoke the wildlife.

contracts.title: Quiet Hands at the Quays
contracts.description: Recover a salvage cache without ever being fully detected by a hostile enemy. The contract fails its bonus if an enemy reaches full alert.

steps.label: Open one cache without raising an alarm

contracts.title: Signs in the Sea Fog
contracts.description: Use the sea fog to investigate two signs of wildlife and retrieve one salvage cache.

contracts.title: Storm-Wreck Recovery
contracts.description: Sail under squall conditions and salvage two separate containers before extracting via a safe route.

contracts.title: Nocturnal Cave Watch
contracts.description: During the night watch, track the tidal-cavern predator and defeat a Salt Widow.

contracts.title: Low-Tide Pilot Survey
contracts.description: Survey three physical traces while the lower shore is exposed. Finish before the tide starts rising.

contracts.title: Salt Yard Bulls
contracts.description: Three Brinebacks have claimed the Salt Yards and the ridge. Bring them down and break a plate for the smith.

contracts.title: Widows of the Caverns
contracts.description: Widows nest in the Tidal Caverns and the Ashwood edge. Find their trail and kill two.

contracts.title: Quiet the Broken Quays
contracts.description: Brineworn gather on the Broken Quays after dark. Put four of them to rest.

contracts.title: Thin the Gull Flocks
contracts.description: Redhook gulls are stripping the fish racks. Drive four of them off for good.

contracts.title: Salvage Run
contracts.description: Open four salvage caches anywhere on the Quays and bring the haul home.

contracts.title: Read the Ground
contracts.description: The guild wants fresh tracks recorded across the Quays.

contracts.title: Shed Horns
contracts.description: The apothecary pays for grazer horn. Break one without killing the herd.

contracts.title: Redhook Beaks
contracts.description: The smith wants two cracked Redhook beaks for fletching tools.

contracts.title: Tusk for the Hall
contracts.description: The Hunters’ Hall wants a Brineback tusk broken in the field.

contracts.title: Wrecker Stash
contracts.description: Wreckers hid scrip in the camp. Open two caches and get out before they notice.

steps.label: Open caches without raising an alarm

contracts.title: Widow Shell Sample
contracts.description: Crack a Salt Widow’s shell for the clinic’s study of brine poison.

contracts.title: Silence the Callers
contracts.description: A Caller is drawing Brineworn to the quays. Find it at night and end the song.

contracts.title: Two Bulls, One Tide
contracts.description: Two Brinebacks have been seen on the shore at low tide. Bring both down.

contracts.title: Records Run
contracts.description: A guild clerk must reach the Customs Forecourt to copy the old records. Walk them there and keep the beasts off.

steps.label: Escort the clerk to the Customs Forecourt

contracts.title: The Keeper’s Heir
contracts.description: The keeper’s son wants to see the lighthouse stump one last time. It is a long walk through the quays.

steps.label: Escort the keeper’s son to the lighthouse

contracts.title: Medicine for the Pilot
contracts.description: A crate of tinctures waits at the Old Fish Market. The pilot at the shed needs it unbroken. Do not get hit more than twice.

steps.label: Carry the fragile crate to the Pilot Shed

contracts.title: Volatile Cargo
contracts.description: Wreckers left blasting powder in their camp. The guild wants it at the Slip gate before the tide. One hit and it is gone.

steps.label: Carry the powder to the Boathouse Slip gate

contracts.title: Tag a Bull
contracts.description: The guild wants a Brineback tagged alive. Wound it badly without killing it and it will run with the tag.

steps.label: Wound a Brineback below a third of its health, but keep it alive

contracts.title: Mark the Widow
contracts.description: A tagged Widow could lead the guild to her nest. Wound one and let it flee.

steps.label: Wound a Salt Widow and let it flee

contracts.title: Keep the Beacon Lit
contracts.description: The watch beacon must burn tonight. Hold the beacon for thirty seconds while the Brineworn come.

contracts.title: Vigil at the Shrine
contracts.description: Keep the night vigil at the ridge shrine. Forty-five seconds. They will come.

steps.label: Keep the vigil at the ridge shrine

contracts.title: Hold the Pilot Shed
contracts.description: Light the signal fire at the Pilot Shed and hold out until the guild boat comes. Every beast on the quays will hear it. You get call-ins: supply drops, mortar barrage, harbor cannon.

steps.label: Light the beacon at the Pilot Shed and survive until evac

contracts.title: Siege of the Fish Market
contracts.description: The guild needs the Old Fish Market held while a crew salvages the ice-house. Longer, harder waves.

steps.label: Light the beacon at the Old Fish Market and survive until evac

contracts.title: The Long Night
contracts.description: At night the Brineworn come in numbers. Hold the Customs Forecourt until dawn boat. Bring everything.

steps.label: Light the beacon at the Customs Forecourt and survive until evac

quests.title: The Empty Skiff
quests.summary: A vessel returned without its crew. Recover its mooring tag and report to the dockmaster.

stages.description: Speak to Mara Fen at the Rest Docks
Recover the mooring tag near the Outer Quays boathouse
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Return the tag to Mara Fen

quests.title: The Second Record
quests.summary: The official list of lost sailors contradicts its pilot copy.

stages.description: Speak with Edda Voss
Retrieve the second ledger from the Customs Warehouse
Extract with the ledger
Deliver the ledger to Edda Voss

quests.title: Cargo Without a Name
quests.summary: Follow a manifest for cargo that officially never existed.

stages.description: Collect the unmarked manifest at Customs
Inspect the experimental cargo cache
Extract from the Outer Quays
Report to Edda Voss

quests.title: Below the Waterline
quests.summary: Search tidal-cave debris for evidence of the missing salvage party.

stages.description: Investigate the Salt Widow cave marker
Recover evidence from the cavern cache
Extract and return to Mara Fen

quests.title: A False King’s Wake
quests.summary: Investigate misleading Drowned King reports around Saltwatch. The real catastrophe is not a routine local raid boss.

stages.description: Collect the false sighting report near the ruined Watch Store
Read the warning board
Extract to the hub
Discuss the evidence with Talla Cor

quests.title: The Harbor Master’s Seal
quests.summary: The nameless cargo was cleared under a harbor master’s seal. Find the seal box on Customs Hill and see what the watch beacon signalled that night.

stages.description: Recover the seal box from the Harbor Master’s Lodge
Inspect the watch beacon on Customs Hill
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Edda Voss

quests.title: Warnings at the Slip
quests.summary: The beacon pointed the crews to the Boathouse Slip. Something there scarred the stones and the crews stopped writing. Read the slip logbook.

stages.description: Examine the harpoon scars on the Boathouse Slip
Recover the Boathouse Slip logbook
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Mara Fen

quests.title: Good Rope Brings Boats Home
quests.summary: Mira needs sound tackle from the old net loft before the next tide. Most of the harbor’s rope rotted in the storm.

stages.description: Search the net loft on Warehouse Row
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Mira Vale

quests.title: Ola’s Lost Tools
quests.summary: Ola left a crate of good tools in a shed near the Old Fish Market when the bell rang. Iven does not know yet.

stages.description: Find the tool crate by the quay shed
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Ola Marr

quests.title: Ash-Grown Remedies
quests.summary: Sera keeps two herb caches out past the Ashwood edge. The clinic is down to its last tinctures.

stages.description: Recover the cache near the Ashwood cabin
Recover the cache under the ruin arch
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Sera Moll

quests.title: Walk the Old Patrol
quests.summary: The watch used to mark three waymarks every night. Nobody has walked the route since the storm. Check that they still stand.

stages.description: Check the West Passage waymark
Check the Storm Gate waymark
Check the lighthouse stump
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Orin Hale

quests.title: The Cairn on the Ridge
quests.summary: Orin swears the old watch left a cairn on Ravine Ridge for the dead of the Ninth Tide. See if it still stands.

stages.description: Find the cairn on Ravine Ridge
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Orin Hale

quests.title: Short Rations
quests.summary: Neral’s count is short. There should still be salted fish at the market and sacks in the salt shed.

stages.description: Recover the salted fish store at the Old Fish Market
Recover ration sacks from the salt shed
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Neral Brin

quests.title: Bells on the Water
quests.summary: Teren needs to know if the buoy bells on the west and east piers still ring. Without them nobody sails at night.

stages.description: Ring the west pier buoy bell
Ring the east pier buoy bell
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Teren Sull

quests.title: Talla’s Missing Crew
quests.summary: Talla’s old crew marked the wreck they worked last. One of them carried a satchel to the Wreckers’ Camp and never came back.

stages.description: Find the crew marker by the eastern wreck
Recover the crew satchel in the Wreckers’ Camp
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Talla Cor

quests.title: Every Crate Counted
quests.summary: Senn keeps the tally. A crate in the Crane Yard was never signed for.

stages.description: Open the unsigned crate in the Crane Yard
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Senn Bri

quests.title: Gears for the Forge
quests.summary: Iven needs good gears. The old saltworks pumps and the rail carts on Customs Hill had the best in the harbor.

stages.description: Salvage the saltworks gearbox
Salvage the rail cart parts on Customs Hill
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Iven Rusk

quests.title: The Keeper’s Last Entry
quests.summary: The lighthouse keeper wrote everything down. Edda wants the log for the ledger before the salt eats it.

stages.description: Recover the keeper’s log at the lighthouse point
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Edda Voss

quests.title: Salt and Shrines
quests.summary: Mara’s mother left offerings at the ridge shrine. Mara wants to know if the relic near the Ashwood edge survived.

stages.description: Visit the ridge shrine
Find the salt-worn relic near the Ashwood edge
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Mara Fen

quests.title: The Thing Under the Slip
quests.summary: The logbook names it: the Tidemaw. It burrows under the Boathouse Slip and floods it when it rises. Break its gills before it calls the tide, and bring it down.

stages.description: Slay the Tidemaw at the Boathouse Slip
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Mara Fen

quests.title: Into the Maw
quests.summary: The Tidemaw at the Slip was only a youngling. Teren has charted where the old ones go to die: a drowned crater the pilots call the Maw. While you carry this quest, the Maw is on the Expedition Chart at the Departure Pier. Sail there and end it.

stages.description: Slay the Elder Tidemaw in the Maw
Extract to Salvager’s Rest
Report back to Teren Sull

quests.title: Ola’s Hammer
quests.summary: Ola dropped her first hammer by the crane when the bell rang. Iven gave it to her. She would rather not tell him.

stages.description: Find the Ola’s Hammer out on the Outer Quays
Return the Ola’s Hammer to Ola Marr

quests.title: The Tarnished Locket
quests.summary: Mara lost her mother’s locket on the beach below the warehouses. The tide may have left it.

stages.description: Find the tarnished locket out on the Outer Quays
Return the Tarnished Locket to Mara Fen

quests.title: The Tally Book
quests.summary: Senn left his tally book in the Bonded Warehouse yard. Without it, half the harbor’s cargo is unaccounted for.

stages.description: Find the senn’s tally book out on the Outer Quays
Return the Senn’s Tally Book to Senn Bri

quests.title: Neral’s Spectacles
quests.summary: Neral lost his spectacles at the Harbor Master’s Lodge counting stock. He can’t read his own ledger.

stages.description: Find the wire spectacles out on the Outer Quays
Return the Wire Spectacles to Neral Brin

quests.title: The Crew Compass
quests.summary: Talla’s old crew compass was left at the ruined watch store. It points true even now.

stages.description: Find the brass compass out on the Outer Quays
Return the Brass Compass to Talla Cor

quests.title: Scrap for the Forge
quests.summary: Iven’s forge eats scrap faster than the harbor can find it. Six pieces will do.

stages.description: Bring 6 × Salt-bitten Scrap to Iven Rusk

quests.title: Salt for the Kitchen
quests.summary: The kitchen needs salt to cure the catch. Four handfuls of crystals.

stages.description: Bring 4 × Red Salt Crystals to Neral Brin

quests.title: Rope for the Docks
quests.summary: The cranes need new lines. Bring Senn three coils of rope.

stages.description: Bring 3 × Dry Rope to Senn Bri

quests.title: Feathers for Fletching
quests.summary: The watch fletches its own bolts. Three Redhook feathers, if you can get them.

stages.description: Bring 3 × Redhook Gull Feather to Orin Hale

quests.title: Oil for the Beacon
quests.summary: Teren keeps a lamp burning on the pilot pier. Two flasks of lamp oil.

stages.description: Bring 2 × Lantern Oil to Teren Sull

quests.title: A Plate for the Hall
quests.summary: The Hunters’ Hall wants a Brineback plate mounted over the door. Edda keeps the record.

stages.description: Bring 1 × Brineback Salt Plate to Edda Voss

quests.title: Ash Tea Leaves
quests.summary: Sera brews her remedies in salted water. Two crystals for the clinic.

stages.description: Bring 2 × Red Salt Crystals to Sera Moll

worldEvents.name: Low-Tide Salvage Window
worldEvents.effect: Lower piers accessible; more salvage reachable

worldEvents.name: Rising Saltwater
worldEvents.effect: Flood lower passages, warn of wildlife movement

worldEvents.name: False King Sighting
worldEvents.effect: Rumor only; no direct Drowned King spawn
